newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic sees early long distance start.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic sees early long distance start.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said on Monday it was using out-of-region long distance offerings to gain experience for a quick start on in-region long distance, which it expects will be a market worth $3.7 billion to it by 2002.
"We want to be ready day one, and to get our 25 percent market share as quickly as we can," Bell Atlantic long distance services president Al Binford said.
Bell Atlantic, which is in the process of merging with NYNEX Corp, is already offering long distance services in Texas, Wisconsin, North Carolina and Michigan.
